notes.title: Gravity Block 2 is OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297267/26770bfd07702452334a83e6c7867d3209f4e1bc.png[/img]

We are very excited to announce that Gravity Block 2 has just been released. After about 4 years, we are back, bringing with us the sequel to our first game, Gravity Block.

Gravity Block 2 is a minimalist puzzle game where you must control the environment to guide the Block to the finish. Featuring new challenges and much harder than its predecessor, Gravity Block 2 offers 50 hand-designed levels, ranging from simple ones to those that will make you cry.

You can get Gravity Block 2 with a 40% launch discount until January 2nd.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3278230/Gravity_Block_2/

You can also purchase the Gravity Block bundle, which includes both games, with a 15% discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47262/Gravity_Block/

A big thank you to all Gravity Block players and future players of Gravity Block 2. Stay tuned as we’ll soon share more news about the future of Atthus Games.

Have fun!
